extracted.name: Seafood Rice
extracted.description: I wanted to try something new and wanted crab rice and I went to work and the family loved it. Let me know if you tried it?
ingredient_lines: Crab meat-your preference on amount or imitation crab meat chopped
instruction_lines: In a pot cook diced bacon until fully cooked and remove and set aside. Reserve drippings
In the pot with the bacon drippings add diced celery, onion, bell pepper and garlic and cook for about 5 minutes.
Add your shrimp to the vegetables and cook then remove from pot and set aside
Toss you crab meat in the pot and Sautee for about 3 minutes
Add the 4 cups of water to the pot and then add your spices to the water and stir
Add your rinsed rice to the seasoned water and bring to a boil then turn on low and cover
After about 10 minutes add the bacon and shrimp and continue to cook covered
Finally when rice is done, stir in the butter and serve
If you want a kick add red pepper flakes
